name: Maanan Purothi
bio:
hi! I'm Maanan Purothi, an incoming third year at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, studying Computer Science and Statistics. I'm the president of [GDG|Google Developer Groups](https://gdg.community.dev/gdg-madison/), a member of the technical team in [WAISI|Wisconsin AI Safety Initiative](https://waisi.org), and a directed study researcher at the [UW Graphics Lab|Co-authoring a paper on visualization guideline creation!].

I love following interesting questions wherever they lead. That has taken me through software, startups, research, and several other rabbit holes. Rather than a [portfolio](https://mp0549.github.io/my-portfolio/), I want this website to be a place to capture the ideas, projects, and experiments that don't really belong on one.

This summer I'm working with Equistamp(https://equistamp.com) as a contractor on their projects with METR(https://metr.org) and [Redwood Research](https://redwoodresearch.org). I'm also continuing my research and various [side projects](/now). If you want to get in touch, feel free to reach out via email or [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/maananpurothi)!

invite.main: I solemnly swear that I am up to something good.
